title: Bring every capsule back to a clean state check
body:
Outcome: krn state check --root . reports clean on main. Observed 2026-11-01: invalid-fixed-point 58c46090 and 8421374d (objects missing from the repository) in .krn/runs/delivery-loop/codex-context/state.md and continuous-delivery/state.md, plus stale-fixed-point warnings across capsules whose leads are idle since 10-30 (open claims t-b6v615x, t-gdct2bc and draft PRs #144 #146 #147). Each owner either resumes, hands off with a valid fixed point, or the operator retires the capsule.
Proof: krn state check --root . prints no error lines; each open claim has a live session or is released.
